market.name: Centreville Luxury Market
market.subhead: A 25% under-contract rate against a 100% success rate — buyers are selective, but every home that sold in this segment sold.

notes: 43176 Bitter Persimmon Ct is the best comp — same street, same year built, within 18 square feet — and it listed and sold at $1,899,900. That home was purchased in 2022 for $1,491,000. A sales price of $1.85M reflects the area’s 24% appreciation since that purchase.

1.21-acre homesite in the Reserve at Holly Springs
Grand foyer opening to formal and casual living spaces
Formal dining room and sitting room
Expansive living room with fireplace
Family room flowing into the kitchen and breakfast space

Custom cabinetry with illuminated display cabinets
Premium stainless steel appliances
Walk-in pantry and sun-filled breakfast nook

premium_rating.label: Upper Level
items: Spacious loft as a secondary gathering space

Primary suite with spa-inspired bath, dual vanities, oversized walk-in shower and soaking tub

premium_rating.label: Lower Level
